node.title: E1 folded kernel certificate soundness
node.statement: For 2-power N', the folded short-vector certificate is sound for E1: if the complete folded search over w in {-2,-1,0,1,2}^{N'/2} finds no nonzero vector with sum_x w_x zeta^x=0 mod p, then every E1 collision is cyclotomic/antipodal and there is no non-quotient exceptional collision at that row.
node.attack_surface: folding identity from kernel_lattice_reframing plus complete finite search semantics
node.falsifier: a row with a non-quotient E1 collision despite a complete folded search reporting no nonzero folded kernel vector
